• Manage the lifecycle of Active Directory objects (users, groups, computers).

• Ensure compliance with naming conventions, directory consistency, and cleanup operations.
• Execute standard requests via ITSM tools.
• Apply validated permissions, policies, and workflows.

o authentication and account lockouts;

RODC Infrastructures
